info.title: swarmy API
info.description: Public, versioned REST API for swarmy. Authenticate with an org-scoped API key: `Authorization: Bearer swk_…`.

post.summary: Drain a node (cordon — stop scheduling, move tasks off)
Deploy a stack from a compose document (async)
Create an API key (plaintext returned once)

201.description: Created — carries the plaintext key (shown once)

post.summary: Create or update a geo-DNS record (upsert by host+region)
Back up a volume now (creates a snapshot)
Restore a snapshot into a volume
Grant a direct mesh route to a service/stack
